name: B10-0090/2025 (ESN) – Case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate release of Boualem Sansal, a 75-year-old French-Algerian writer arrested in Algiers in November 2024 over comments about Algeria's borders with Morocco. It says nobody should be jailed for expressing an opinion. It also raises concern about discrimination against Christians in Algeria and the closure of non-Muslim places of worship, and asks for checks on how EU money sent to Algeria to protect religious minorities is actually used.

- The Parliament asks Algeria to free Boualem Sansal; it affects him and his family.
- It wants EU funds to Algeria checked for protecting religious minorities; this affects Christians there.
- It is only an opinion; the Parliament cannot force Algeria to act.
